posts.headline: Week 5 Wall: The League Hits the Gauntlet
posts.body: Team Minty Fresh and Computer Jocks walk into a buzz saw, their schedules jumped to elite difficulty. Three undefeated teams built their records on cupcake slates. The reckoning starts now.
content: Boom — Week 5 is the league-wide wall, and I'm told the schedule just got significantly meaner. Average opponent difficulty across the AFL sits at 41, meaning every contender is about to face a gauntlet of elite competition. But two teams are getting it worse than everyone else: Team Minty Fresh and Computer Jocks both own difficulty 44 in the Gauntlet rankings, and their remaining schedules just got harder — up 9 and 10 spots respectively. These two are running into a buzz saw when the league needs wins most.

The rest of the top tier isn't much prettier. Avenging Amish, Suh girls, one cup, Muck Juggling Micks, Badd Boys, Chatmaster, and The Show are all locked at difficulty 43, facing average remaining opponents scoring 123-plus PPG. Badd Boys had the sharpest one-week jump — their schedule went up 11 spots — so watch them closely. League sources tell me that cluster of eight teams is about to separate the pretenders from contenders in a hurry.

Here's where it gets ugly: three undefeated teams built their records on soft slates and are about to pay the price. Dicks out for Harambe sits 6-0 against the softest schedule in the league (past difficulty 33), and The Mariachi Ninjas are 6-0 against a past difficulty of 40. Midwestside Connection is 5-1 against a laughably easy slate (past difficulty 29). Their records flatter them. Check the standings now, but expect major movement as reality hits.

The flip side: Titsburgh Feelers and Titsburgh Feelers — sorry, league sources tell me Titsburgh Feelers got the biggest schedule relief, down 13 spots — along with No Soup For You and Jewpacabra are catching breathers. If you own one of those teams, this is your trade window to capitalize before opponents toughen up again.

Money is nice, but championships are better, and this is where Week 5 separates buyers from sellers. Check the full Gauntlet rankings — the heat map and week-by-week grid will show you exactly which teams are about to hit the wall and which have dodged the bullet.

posts.headline: Week 4 Wall: The Gauntlet Gets Real, Records Get Exposed
posts.body: Dicks out for Harambe and Midwestside Connection have been cruising through a cupcake schedule, but the Gauntlet is about to humble them. Meanwhile, The Show's 0-5 record masks a championship-caliber roster.
content: Boom — Week 4 is the league-wide reckoning. I'm told the average opponent difficulty spikes to 41 this week, and that's where soft-schedule records finally meet the buzzsaw. League sources tell me that the Gauntlet rankings show Titsburgh Feelers sitting atop the hardest remaining slate at difficulty 46, with opponents averaging 125.5 PPG. Get off my Ditka and Da Dangsters are breathing down their neck at 45, both watching their schedules toughen considerably. This is the gauntlet, and contenders are about to find out who they really are.

Here's the killer: Dicks out for Harambe is 5-0, but I'm told they've been padding that record against a soft slate with past difficulty 31. That record flatters them hard. Same deal with Midwestside Connection, sitting 4-1 against a brutal past difficulty of just 23 — both teams are about to walk into the meat grinder. The Show, meanwhile, is 0-5, but league sources tell me they've been grinding through a brutal slate with past difficulty 57. That record is a lie. This team is better than the record, and when they hit the standings in Week 5, everyone's going to wish they'd noticed sooner.

The schedule movers this week tell the whole story. Chatmaster just jumped 10 spots up the difficulty rankings — their remaining opponents got significantly harder. On the flip side, Badd Boys dropped 15 spots as their road eased up considerably. Smokane FC also caught a breather, down 15 from last week. Money is nice, but championships are better, and if you've got the assets to shore up your depth before the gauntlet hits, the trade builder will show you exactly what a fair deal looks like.

Suh girls, one cup actually got easier this week despite sitting at difficulty 44 — that's the rare team managing schedule luck in their favor. But most of the top 10 saw their roads get harder. No Soup For You, Avenging Amish, Muck Juggling Micks — they're all facing tougher roads ahead. The elite win anyway. The pretenders show up here.
Want the full breakdown week by week? Check the Gauntlet rankings — heat map, grid, the whole dashboard. This is where records get made and reputations get exposed.
